PATTERN: On UserPromptSubmit, set needsFocusUpdate=true and extract prompt heuristic as immediate placeholder. On first PreToolUse, read transcript JSONL tail (200KB), find latest assistant message entries, extract first sentence containing an action verb. Upgrade currentFocus if found; keep prompt heuristic as fallback.

WHERE: /api/hooks/user-prompt/route.ts (sets flag + heuristic), /api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts (reads transcript, calls extractFocusFromAssistant)

HOW: Transcript tail read with 200KB buffer (30KB was too small — tool_result entries are huge). Parse JSONL lines, filter type=assistant, extract text content from content array. Find sentences with action verbs (fix, build, check, read, add, etc.) as focus.

WHY: User prompt is noisy ('check hooks and shit'). Claude's response ('Let me audit all hook scripts and clean up the UI') is already the semantic interpretation.

GOTCHA: 30KB tail was too small — file is 10MB+, assistant entries sparse. Must use 200KB+.
